title: Crossing the Conversational Chasm: A Primer on Natural Language Processing for Multilingual Task-Oriented Dialogue Systems

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating linguistic diversity indices (typological, family, and geographical macroarea entropy) of existing multilingual datasets and conducting cross-lingual transfer experiments to demonstrate the performance limitations of default English-centric models.

Evaluating dataset creation methods by comparing translation-based data (which often carries 'translationese' and English-speaking cultural assumptions) against localized, natively generated conversational data.
